headline: Alpha Geoclaw Tips
title: Alpha Geoclaw Tips | Break the Ice Prison With Fire | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Alpha Geoclaw can trap you in an Ice Prison, and basic attacks barely scratch it. Use a Fire skill to shatter the ice fast, then dodge the heavy attack that follows. This boss is Ice, so Fire and Earth hit it hardest. When it tunnels underground, ranged attacks do nothing, but Pound skills knock it back out. To unlock the fight, feed one hundred twenty Lumin Amber to the Breezy Plains Branch. Ready to fight it? Comment below!

scenes.sub: Break it with a Fire skill
Use Pound skills to hit it

description: Alpha Geoclaw tips in Aniimo: break its Ice Prison with a Fire skill, bring Fire or Earth attackers, use Pound skills when it tunnels, and unlock it with one hundred twenty Lumin Amber at the Breezy Plains Branch.
